content: {"reasoning":"CPT 93229 requires prior authorization, which is missing, and this payer does not offer retroactive authorization. Submitting with records would not cure that requirement; there is no denial to appeal, and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. Billing the full balance to the patient would exceed the contractual patient share, so escalate for specialist review because no available automated action can properly progress the claim.","action":"escalate"}
